core_files.server.ts: The backend Express API. Handles endpoints like /api/interact and /api/weaver.
core_files.src/App.tsx: Main application file handling state, microphone stt, stasis overlay, and chat.
core_files.src/components/Scene.tsx: Main 3D Scene container handling environments (Void, Neon City, Junkyard, Rainforest, Desert, Ancient Cave).
core_files.src/components/EnvironmentObjects.tsx: Renders objects spawned into the environment.

state_variables.mochiEmotion: Current emotion to display on avatar.
state_variables.isUpgrading: Set to true during surgery (write_code). Freezes physics and displays stasis overlay.

rules.dynamic_components: Only write new UI fragments to src/dynamic_components/.
rules.syntax: Ensure all brackets match. Do not overwrite App.tsx.
